title: Database Foundation
description: Establish global Kysely database integration with all tables, types, and a single initial migration.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines Database interface including tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks, task_comments — every table includes tenant_id: string except organizations
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active columns
001_initial.ts creates ALL tables with correct columns, CHECK constraints, foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE, and indexes exactly as specified in requirements in a single migration
Role CHECK constraint matches exactly: ('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')
Project status CHECK constraint matches exactly: ('Active','Archived')
Task status CHECK constraint matches exactly: ('ToDo','InProgress','Completed')
All foreign keys enforce tenant isolation via tenant_id columns
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implements user registration, login, refresh token handling, JWT validation, role decorators, and global auth guard.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register marked with @Public()
RegisterDto has email, password, first_name, last_name, organization_name with exact validation rules from requirements
Register endpoint creates organization and user in a single transaction and hardcodes role to 'Member'
Register endpoint hashes password with bcrypt using 12 salt rounds
Register endpoint returns exactly { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/login marked with @Public()
LoginDto validates email and password as required strings
Login endpoint returns exactly { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Login throws UnauthorizedException for invalid credentials
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/refresh marked with @Public() and returns new access_token
JWT payload contains sub, email, role, tenant_id exactly
jwt.strategy.ts validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id }
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD
@Public() decorator bypasses global guard
@Roles() decorator stores roles metadata
RolesGuard enforces exact role string match and throws ForbiddenException
AuthModule is imported into app.module.ts
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator

title: Organizations Module
description: Allows creation of an organization with its first Admin user and returns JWT tokens.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations marked with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto validates email, password, first_name, last_name, organization_name
Endpoint creates organization and first user with role 'Admin' in a transaction
Password hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Endpoint returns exactly { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Email must be globally unique else throw ConflictException
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped user listing and role management.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users with pagination query params page and limit
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users filters strictly by tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
UsersController exposes PATCH /api/users/:id/role
PATCH /api/users/:id/role requires @Roles('Admin')
UpdateUserRoleDto validates role with @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
Cannot change own role — throws BadRequestException
User must belong to same tenant or throw NotFoundException
Every query includes .where('tenant_id', '=', tenantId)
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Provides full project lifecycle management with tenant enforcement and role-based access.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto validates name required max 150 and description optional max 1000
POST sets status default 'Active' and tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects with pagination for all authenticated users
GET /api/projects filters by tenant_id
ProjectsController exposes PATCH /api/projects/:id requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
UpdateProjectDto validates optional name, description, status with @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
Cannot modify archived project except status change
ProjectsController exposes DELETE /api/projects/:id requiring @Roles('Admin')
DELETE cascades tasks and task_comments via DB constraint
All queries include tenant_id filter
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Implements task management within projects with strict tenant and ownership enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateTaskDto validates title required max 200, description optional max 2000, assignee_id required UUID
POST verifies project belongs to tenant and assignee exists in same tenant
POST sets status default 'ToDo'
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks with pagination for all authenticated users
GET /api/tasks filters strictly by tenant_id
TasksController exposes PATCH /api/tasks/:id
PATCH allows Admin and ProjectManager full access
PATCH allows Member only if task.assignee_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
UpdateTaskDto validates status with @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
TasksController exposes DELETE /api/tasks/:id requiring @Roles('Admin')
DELETE cascades task_comments via DB constraint
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', tenantId)
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Task Comments Module
description: Enables authenticated users to create and list comments on tenant-scoped tasks.
acceptance_criteria: TaskCommentsController exposes POST /api/tasks/:taskId/comments for all authenticated users
CreateTaskCommentDto validates content required max 1000
POST verifies task belongs to tenant and sets author_id = req.user.id
TaskCommentsController exposes GET /api/tasks/:taskId/comments with pagination
GET filters by tenant_id and task_id
GET returns { data: Comment[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries include tenant_id filter
TaskCommentsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TaskCommentsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provides aggregated tenant dashboard metrics and basic in-app notifications listing.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard/summary for all authenticated users
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns exactly { total_projects, total_tasks, tasks_by_status: { ToDo, InProgress, Completed } } filtered by tenant_id
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications with pagination
GET /api/notifications returns { data: [], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries include tenant_id filter
Both controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped audit logging for critical actions across the system.
acceptance_criteria: Adds audit_logs table in 001_initial.ts including id, tenant_id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id, created_at
types.ts includes audit_logs table definition with tenant_id: string
AuditLogsController exposes GET /api/audit-logs with pagination
GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET filters strictly by tenant_id
AuditLogsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditLogsModule is added to app.module.ts imports
